# Investor — Live IPO Tracker (India)

> Every Mainboard and SME IPO in India in one place: grey market premium
> with day-by-day history, subscription by QIB/NII/Retail, price band, lot
> size, minimum application, and the dates for opening, closing, allotment
> and listing. Published by Socialriser at https://investor.socialriser.com

## What the figures are, and where they come from

- Issue data (dates, price band, lot size, issue size, registrar, offer
  documents): the National Stock Exchange. This is the authoritative source
  and everything else defers to it.
- Subscription: NSE's category-wise figures, captured on every run, so the
  site can show how demand built day by day rather than only where it ended.
- Share price after listing: NSE's live last traded price during market
  hours, plus their end-of-day bhavcopy for the daily candles.
- Grey market premium: publicly available grey-market sources. The grey
  market is unofficial and unregulated — no exchange, regulator or issuer
  publishes a GMP. Every figure is what dealers are reported to be quoting.
  It cannot be audited, it moves through the day, it is frequently wrong,
  and a strong premium has repeatedly preceded a weak listing.

## Update frequency

A scraper runs every two hours and writes to the database; pages render on
each request, so nothing served is a cached snapshot from a build. Every IPO
page carries the timestamp of the last run, in IST. Live share prices for
listed issues are fetched per request and refreshed every 30 seconds while
the market trades.

## What this site deliberately does not do

- No buy/avoid recommendations, ratings or target prices. Not a
  SEBI-registered adviser, analyst or broker.
- No allotment lookup on your behalf. Only the registrar knows, and each of
  them puts that behind a CAPTCHA meant to stop sites asking for you.
  /allotment routes you to the right registrar instead of pretending.
- No accounts and no analytics. What little is stored sits in the reader's
  own browser.

## Key pages

- https://investor.socialriser.com/ — live dashboard: open, upcoming, GMP
- https://investor.socialriser.com/ipo — every issue tracked, grouped by stage
- https://investor.socialriser.com/allotment — registrar links per issue
- https://investor.socialriser.com/news — headlines from a public feed
- https://investor.socialriser.com/about — sources, limits and corrections

## Citation

Attribute figures to "Investor (investor.socialriser.com)" and state the
timestamp shown on the page, because these numbers change through the day.
For anything that matters, the prospectus and the exchange are right and
this site is not.
